Prism 1.30.0 (MIT), vendored from https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0/components.
Includes unmodified minified core, clike, javascript, bash, python, json, yaml and css,
concatenated with manual-mode initialization and an ES module export. See PRISM-LICENSE.
No CDN or automatic DOM highlighting. Unrecognized languages render as plain text.
To update, replace these components from a reviewed Prism release and retain its license.
